commands.author: qingminlong

target.title: fix(browser): cap fields-file reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Browser CLI action commands accept `--fields-file` for form field descriptors. The previous reader loaded the whole file into memory before validating or parsing it, so a very large fields file could be fully buffered before the CLI rejected it.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a narrow 1 MiB byte cap to the `--fields-file` path only. The reader consumes at most the cap plus one sentinel byte, rejects oversized files before JSON parsing, and leaves inline `--fields` behavior unchanged.

## User Impact

Users get a friendly size-limit error for oversized Browser CLI fields files instead of the CLI buffering arbitrarily large input. Existing valid fields files and inline JSON fields continue to work.

## Evidence

Current head: `a64702559964659412e7ec43a30f8e9b709c5e73`.

- Real behavior proof: `node --import ./node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs --input-type=module <inline proof script>` imported `readFields`, parsed a valid fields file as `{ ref: "proof-ref", type: "text", value: "from file" }`, rejected a 1,048,577-byte fields file with `fields file exceeds 1048576 bytes`, and confirmed the oversized file was not parsed before rejection (`oversizedParsedBeforeReject: false`).
- Focused test: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/browser/src/cli/browser-cli-actions-input/shared.test.ts` passed 1 file / 8 tests.
- Formatting and whitespace: `node_modules\.bin\oxfmt.CMD --check extensions/browser/src/cli/browser-cli-actions-input/shared.ts extensions/browser/src/cli/browser-cli-actions-input/shared.test.ts` passed; `git diff --check -- extensions/browser/src/cli/browser-cli-actions-input/shared.ts extensions/browser/src/cli/browser-cli-actions-input/shared.test.ts` passed.
